case_title: Parveen @ Sonu v. The State of Haryana
previous_criminal_record: Yes, acquitted of offences under Sections 392, 216 r/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code
confession: Alleged confessional statements of co-accused, but not relied on
neutral_facts: The accused were being escorted by a police party to be produced in court. Four young boys entered their compartment and attacked the police party, attempting to rescue the accused. One of the accused fired upon a head constable, who later succumbed to firearm injuries. The prosecution relied on eyewitness accounts, medical reports, and statements from police officers to connect the accused to the crime. However, there was no direct evidence linking the appellant to the incident, and the investigating agency did not conduct a test identification parade. The appellant had a prior acquittal for a different offense.
